requirements.title: DIGITS result value is q for integer X and p for real X
requirements.definition: The DIGITS result has value q for integer X and p for real X, where q and p are defined in 16.4 for the model representing numbers of the same type and kind as X.

pending.digits-integer-model-q: Future fixture cross-checks DIGITS(integer_kind) against other registered integer model inquiries such as BIT_SIZE/RADIX/HUGE where 16.4 fixes the relation; it does not assert a processor-independent q for every kind.
pending.digits-real-model-p: Future fixture cross-checks DIGITS(real_kind) against registered real model inquiries for the same kind; it avoids hard-coding processor-specific precision except where 16.4 minimums alone are asserted.
pending.digits-same-kind-same-model-value: Use different integer values and an integer array of the same kind, and different real values of the same kind, asserting DIGITS results are equal within each type/kind; no equality is asserted across different kind models.

requirements.oracle: DIGITS returns exact model parameters for the executing processor, but most numeric values are processor dependent across kinds. Pending plans therefore assert model consistency and source-mandated kind/rank behavior, not a universal precision for every processor.
